decision_table.name: Determine_IL_Filing_Requirement
decision_table.description: Determine if corporation must file IL state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

condition.name: has_physical_presence
condition.comment: Has physical presence in IL (office, employees, property)

actions.action: // Physical nexus established - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
IL filing required due to physical presence (office, employees, or property in state).
Reference: IL Income Tax Act, 35 ILCS 5/201 Reference: IL Department of Revenue Publication 101 (Income Tax Law and Regulations) Reference: 86 Ill. Admin. Code § 100.9710 (Allocation and Apportionment)

actions.action: // Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
IL filing required due to economic nexus (post-Wayfair). Threshold: $100,000 in IL gross receipts OR 200 transactions.
Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018) Reference: 35 ILCS 5/1501(a)(1) Reference: IL Department of Revenue ST 19-0001-GIL (Economic Nexus Guidance)
No IL nexus - no filing requirement. Any estimated payments would be refunded.

decision_table.name: Calculate_IL_Income_Adjustments
decision_table.description: Calculate IL state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments

rule.policy:
IL state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income.
Additions may include: - Interest on U.S. government obligations (35 ILCS 5/203(a)(2)(G)) - IRC Section 199A qualified business income deduction addback - Depreciation adjustments for pre-2012 assets
Subtractions may include: - Interest on IL state and local government bonds - IL state income taxes paid
Reference: IL Form IL-1120 Instructions Reference: 35 ILCS 5/203 (Base income defined) Reference: 86 Ill. Admin. Code § 100.2110 (Additions and Subtractions)
No nexus - no state adjustments calculated.

decision_table.name: Calculate_IL_State_Tax
decision_table.description: Calculate IL state corporate income tax. Applies IL 9.5% tax rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to owe tax

rule.policy:
IL state corporate income tax calculation:
1. Federal taxable income: [Form 1120 line 28] 2. Apportioned to IL: × [Apportionment %] 3. State additions: + [Additions] 4. State subtractions: - [Subtractions] 5. IL taxable income: = [Result] 6. IL tax rate: × 9.5% (highest in the nation) 7. IL income tax: = [Tax before credits] 8. IL credits: - [Credits] 9. IL tax liability (before replacement tax): = [Tax]
Note: Personal Property Replacement Tax (2.5%) calculated separately. Total effective IL corporate tax rate is 12.0% (9.5% + 2.5%).
Reference: IL Form IL-1120 Instructions Reference: 35 ILCS 5/201(b) (Tax rate: 9.5%) Reference: 35 ILCS 5/201(c) (Replacement tax: 2.5%) Reference: 86 Ill. Admin. Code § 100.2250 (Computation of tax)
No IL nexus - no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded.
No IL taxable income - no tax liability. IL NOL rules may apply (not implemented).

decision_table.name: Calculate_IL_Replacement_Tax
decision_table.description: Calculate IL Personal Property Replacement Tax (PPRT). Replacement tax is 2.5% of net income.

condition.name: has_positive_tax_base
condition.comment: Has positive tax base for replacement tax calculation

rule.policy:
IL Personal Property Replacement Tax (PPRT) applies to corporations.
Replacement Tax Calculation: - Net income base: [State taxable income] - Replacement tax rate: × 2.5% - Replacement tax: = [Replacement tax amount] - Total IL tax: Income tax (9.5%) + Replacement tax (2.5%) = 12.0%
The replacement tax applies to the same income base as the income tax. It was enacted to replace revenue lost when the personal property tax on corporations was abolished by the 1970 Illinois Constitution.
The replacement tax revenue is distributed to local governments to replace the lost personal property tax revenue.
Reference: 35 ILCS 5/201(c) (Replacement tax rate: 2.5%) Reference: 35 ILCS 5/201(d) (Replacement tax base) Reference: IL Form IL-1120 Instructions (Schedule of Replacement Tax) Reference: 86 Ill. Admin. Code § 100.2260 (Personal Property Replacement Tax)
No replacement tax - no IL nexus.
No replacement tax - no positive tax base.
